title: kubecon-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
Purpose: master scratchpad for travel admin + expenses reminders for KubeCon NA 2026. Use as single source for receipts, vendor contacts, logistics, and expense submission notes.

Attendees (Redwood):
- Nina Park (lead admin)
- Jordan Kim (eng)
- Samantha Lee (solutions)
- Alex Martinez (sales)
- Laura Chen (marketing, joining for booth)

High-level deadlines:
- Book travel + hotel by 2026-03-05 (preferred) — group rate expires 2026-03-10
- Prepay shipping for booth materials by 2026-03-15
- Expense submission cutoff: submit all expenses in Expensify within 7 days after event (by 2026-04-05)
- Visa letters: request by 2026-03-01 if needed (check passports)

Travel / Flights:
- Group booking code: RW-KC26 (call travel team if issues)
- Reminder: pick refundable vs non-refundable depending on traveler preference. Put fare class in expense description.
- Itinerary template to collect from each attendee: flight number, arrival/departure times, hotel check-in/out, emergency contact.

Hotel:
- Conference hotel: Moscone Plaza Hotel (block: Redwood Inference KubeCon 2026)
- Check-in: 2026-04-12, Check-out: 2026-04-16 (typical)
- Room charge policy: personal incidentals will be billed to personal cards — include clear instructions for splitting if needed.

Badge & Registration:
- Registration contact: events@kubecon.org (confirm badge names by 2026-03-20)
- Entitlements: 1 exhibitor + 3 speaker badges included; extra badges $299 each. Track purchases in the tracker sheet.

Booth Logistics / Shipping:
- Booth ship-to: Moscone Center, Attn: Exhibitor Services — Redwood Inference / Booth #B12
- Freeman (official drayage): Contact: Miguel Torres, miguel.torres@freeman.com, +1 415-555-0183
- Shipping deadlines: inbound by 2026-04-10; outbound pickup scheduled for 2026-04-16 evening. Confirm pickup label details with Freeman.
- Local AV vendor (onsite): WestCo AV — primary: Rachel Gomez, r.gomez@westcoav.com, +1 415-555-0122. Projector + mics reserved. Confirm setup time and breakout room AV by 2026-04-08.

Expense rules / reminders:
- Preferred tool: Expensify. Use policy "Events-Redwood". If receipts > $75, must attach photo/scan.
- Food per diem: $60/day for local team (check policy for speakers vs exhibitors).
- Taxis / rides: include route/ride share screenshot or receipt, and note client meeting if applicable.
- Shipping and booth costs should be coded to cost center: CC-ENG-EVT-2026 (confirm with finance). Put "KubeCon 2026" in expense memo.
- Currency: default USD — if reimbursing local vendors in EUR/GBP, capture exchange rate and include expense note.

Receipt naming convention (for quicker finance processing):
- YYYYMMDD_vendor_category_amount_traveler (e.g., 20260412_Freeman_shipping_852_NinaPark.jpg)

Vendor contacts quick list:
- Freeman (drayage): Miguel Torres — miguel.torres@freeman.com — +1 415-555-0183
- WestCo AV (AV/setup): Rachel Gomez — r.gomez@westcoav.com — +1 415-555-0122
- Catering (booth snacks): BayBites Catering — events@baybites.com — +1 415-555-0147
- Shipping (overnight): FastShip Logistics — ops@fastship.com — +1 800-555-0199

Onsite admin checklist (day-by-day):
- Day -2 (arrivals): confirm hotel rooming list, confirm incoming freight arrival with Freeman
- Day -1 (setup): meet AV vendor at 10:00am, assemble booth crates, confirm internet access and badge pick-up location
- Day 0 (conference start): check-in at exhibitor services, confirm daily staffing schedule, confirm booth phone charger / spare battery stash
- Daily: collect receipts, take photo of all invoices, upload to Expensify same day

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm final booth number (current placeholder B12) — ACTION: Jordan to confirm with events ops (due 2026-03-03)
- Confirm exact number of complimentary badges and speakers list — ACTION: Samantha to sync with registry (due 2026-03-08)
- Decide whether to ship extra laptops or rent locally (cost tradeoff) — ACTION: Nina to get rental quote from WestCo AV by 2026-03-12
- Confirm finance coding (CC-ENG-EVT-2026) with Finance (Finance contact: Priya Shah) — ACTION: Nina (by 2026-03-05)

Quick notes / hacks:
- Keep a shared Google Photos album for receipts and snapshots (link in linked_artifacts).
- If someone pays personally for large vendor invoice, pre-approve in Slack #events with finance CC to speed reimbursement. Take screenshot of approval and attach to expense.

Past references (for template):
- Past KubeCon 2024 expense checklist (see Confluence link in linked_artifacts)
- Booth shipping label template in GitHub repo (linked above)

Contact escalation:
- If any vendor no-shows, escalate to Events Ops (events-ops@redwood.ai) and CC Nina Park + Jordan Kim.

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc minimal and actionable. Move finalized checklists into Confluence runbook post-event.
- After event, create a short write-up with lessons-learned and attach sample receipts for finance training.
summary: Scratchpad for KubeCon NA 2026 travel/admin: deadlines, attendees, vendors, expenses, checklists, and action items.
